svg.text: Seven modules — one must-know each, plus OSCE stations (NG-TCM-0014)

g.text: M01 — Define TCAM + pluralism; why patients combine systems
M02 — Healer types + crafts; five remedy families + belief roots
M03 — Interaction triads (warfarin/diabetes/BP) + pregnancy red list + surgery stops
M04 — Massage 7 contraindications (DVT NEVER!) + 4Q evidence check + scope line
M05 — Kleinman 8 + LEARN 5 + disclosure rules + 5-line note
M06 — Act 595 + FDA numbers + two-way referrals + ward checklist
M07 — Capstone wheel: ASK → SAFETY → SORT → SHARE → BRIDGE → SUSTAIN
Cross-cutting — both-and language · quoted beliefs · review dates · teach-back
Cross-cutting — harm refused + documented + reported via channels, always
Counsel the warfarin + bitters patient · Take a TM history · Negotiate the prayer-camp discharge
Teach 4-2-6 breathing · Check an FDA number · Write a 5-line negotiated note

svg.text: Examiners reward safety + respect + documentation — in that order. Original NurseGrid content.
